proposal.summary: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap that may allow a malicious actor to exhaust the process memory.
proposal.cwe_quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap. This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
